release_read.basis: Q4 revenue guide $245-275m (mid $260m) sits about 20% under the $319-343m Q4 consensus the hunt cited, and the non-GAAP gross margin guide of 17-21% is far below Q3's 34.7% (itself flattered by a $36.0m IEEPA benefit), so the Q3 EPS beat is low quality; the Q2 analogue on a guide miss was -30.5%, shrunk for the 18% short interest and a 12.8% implied move.

release.headline: SolarEdge Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.note: consensus not found in time; inside the company's own $310-340m Q3 guide (midpoint $325m)

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback)
vs_bar.note: beat driven largely by a $36.0m IEEPA tariff benefit in gross margin; GAAP EPS $(0.14)

key_line.metric: Q4 revenue and gross margin guide
key_line.detail: Q4 revenue $245-275m, non-GAAP gross margin 17-21%, opex $87-91m, excluding potential IEEPA refunds; implies a return to a non-GAAP operating loss.

guidance.detail: Q4 revenue guide $245-275m against a street at $319-343m; margin guide 17-21% against Q3 guide of 22-26% and Q3 actual 34.7% (IEEPA-boosted).

call.detail: Call at 08:00 ET this morning, before this review; content not yet read.

thesis_check.note: The panel shorted on a Q4 guide below the street after Enphase's weak Q4 guide; the guide came in at $245-275m against $319-343m.

recommendation.reason: Voorlopig: de vooruitzichten voor Q4 liggen ruim onder wat analisten verwachtten, wat de short-these bevestigt. Definitief advies volgt na de pre-market koers.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Een pre-market koers die al verder daalt dan de vooruitzichten rechtvaardigen.
